Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-018 - URL switches persist across navigation and disable cleanly after removal

parameters.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'Finance' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, below the FINANCE heading and beneath the 'Approvals' link; it navigates client-side while retaining the active mock read-failure switch.

parameters.script: return {href: location.href, path: location.pathname, search: location.search, hasMock: location.search.includes('mock=1'), hasSimulateError: location.search.includes('simulateError=1'), heading: document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText || '', body: document.body.innerText.slice(0,900), rawExceptionTerms: /stack trace|TypeError|Unhandled Promise|authorization|token|credential|secret/i.test(document.body.innerText)}
